title: WaterSound Crossings C-112 - 100 S Bridge Lane
h1: WaterSound Crossings C-112 - 100 S Bridge Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Great views of the Gulf and natural sand dunes- Fantastic porch spaces- Pool and beach are just yards away- From March 1st to October 31st, 2024, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private deeded beach access- Free WiFi- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforters, laundered upon every checkout*This property comes with 1 designated parking space and 1 first-come first-serve parking space. Please note first come first serve parking is limited and not guaranteed. This condo permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.*Beginning in March 2025 and continuing through 2026, the WaterSound Crossings condominiums will undergo an extensive exterior refurbishment project. During this period, residents and guests should expect significant construction activity, including the boarding of windows and restricted access to balconies in affected buildings. These measures are necessary to ensure safety and facilitate the successful completion of the work.DETAILS: This newly renovated three bedroom Crossings condo has been outfitted with an extra bunk room. Beautifully decorated and meticulously maintained this is perfect for your WaterSound vacation escape. Gulf front accommodations and picture perfect views make this a one-of-a-kind beach retreat. This home is graciously appointed with stylish furnishings and has that beach chic feel. The living room offers large floor-to-ceiling windows with a view of the gulf and beautiful furnishings that complement the tropical atmosphere. Relax and unwind curled up with a book or watching a movie on the large, flat screen television. The attached dining area provides a large, natural wood table with seating for six and access to the furnished balcony to lounge and enjoy the gulf air. Be prepared to be swept off of your feet as you soak in some of the most beautiful dune and gulf views on 30A. The kitchen in this beautiful home leaves nothing to be desired. With stainless steel appliances, gorgeous granite counters, and rich wood cabinetry, this kitchen is fully equipped to help you cook up any kind of meal. The Primary Suite is beautifully decorated in hues of sky blue and offers plenty of space as well as a TV, balcony access, and a gorgeous spa-like bathroom. Enjoy the large jetted tub or the extra-large walk in shower, as well as double vanities. The newly retrofitted bunkroom off the primary bedroom is perfect for the kids to have nautical getaway. The second bedroom directly off the kitchen invites guest a retreat with its large queen bedroom and a connected bathroom with single vanity and shower. The third bedroom has two twin beds, perfect for extra guests. This room offers bright and fun furnishings, as well as TV and a connected bath with tub and shower.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 8) FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub- Hallway Bunks: Twin over Twin Bunk bedSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds, Private Bathroom With Shower/TubAMENITIES INCLUDE: Community Pool, Gulf Views, and 1 parking spot. Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter comforters, are laundered upon every checkout. 360 BLUE STAFF & SERVICES: Exclusive Guest Experiences, Concierge Services, Grocery Delivery, Private Chef & More (Extra costs & advanced notice may be required)*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
